summary: Round r1 (restricted network). For each of the 20 exposure-register entries (EXP-01..EXP-20) the exact primary documents and tables that would measure it were located as source leads (NRB Current Macroeconomic and Financial Situation and FDI survey, NSO NLSS IV and Census 2021, MoLESS/DoFE labour migration reports, Department of Customs trade statistics, PDMO debt statistics, NOC, NEA, CAAN, tourism statistics, FATF/APG, WTO/UN CDP, ICIMOD, BIS, KNOMAD, World Bank IDS). No values were retrieved; all concentration metrics (13 defined, HHI and top-k shares by partner for trade, remittances, migrants, fuel, FDI, debt, tourism, electricity, aviation, essential imports and correspondent banking) are pending. Twelve candidate single points of failure are identified qualitatively (single petroleum supplier and India-only routes, Indian transit ports, northern crossings with China, GCC/Malaysia labour markets, India open-border migration, TIA and Gulf hubs, correspondent banking under FATF monitoring, India as sole electricity market, India-sourced fertiliser/medicines/food, the NPR-INR peg, upstream Tibetan cryosphere hazards, multilateral creditor concentration). Nine new exposure entries are proposed; the register file was not edited.

findings.claim: Q1 trade: partner concentration of goods imports and exports (India share, HHI) for the latest complete Nepal FY.
findings.note: Customs annual FTS partner tables FY2023/24-FY2024/25 or trade-portal extracts; NRB CME trade-by-country table; mirror data for conflict check.

findings.claim: Q1 remittances: remittances/GDP and corridor shares by sending country.
findings.note: NRB personal remittances FY2024/25; NSO nominal GDP same FY; NLSS IV Chapter 16 and microdata; KNOMAD bilateral matrix latest vintage.

findings.claim: Q1 migrants: labour approvals and migrant stock by destination.
findings.note: DoFE approvals by country FY2022/23-FY2025/26; Census 2021 absentees by destination; GCC host-country counts.

findings.claim: Q1 fuel: petroleum share of imports and supplier/route shares.
findings.note: NOC import volumes by product and supplier; customs HS 27 by partner and customs office.

findings.claim: Q1 FDI: FDI stock by source country.
findings.note: NRB FDI survey 2023/24 country table; DoI approvals kept separate.

findings.claim: Q1 debt: external public debt by creditor and currency.
findings.note: PDMO Government Debt Statistics creditor and currency tables (latest month), IDS creditor series.

findings.claim: Q1 tourism: arrivals share by origin and travel receipts/GDP.
findings.note: Nepal Tourism Statistics 2024 nationality table (calendar year); NRB travel receipts (FY).

findings.claim: Q1 electricity: exports/imports by counterparty and season.
findings.note: NEA annual report energy-balance tables FY2024/25.

findings.claim: Q2 single points of failure: severity of each of SPOF-01..12 is unquantified.

Concentration is measured by the Herfindahl-Hirschman index of partner shares (0-10000 scale) plus top-1/top-3 shares, computed separately for each source and period basis; values from methodologically different sources (e.g. NLSS vs KNOMAD corridors) are never merged.

Single points of failure are identified where a route, supplier, market, institution or hazard source is (a) concentrated and (b) lacks a short-run substitute; the list is qualitative until quantified.

data_gaps: Remittances by sending country are not (to be verified) published by NRB; only survey (NLSS IV) and modelled (KNOMAD) corridor data were located.
Latest Department of Customs annual trade book (FY2023/24, FY2024/25) not located as a direct file; only FY2022/23 book and trade portal.
DoFE yearly progress reports for FY2024/25 and FY2025/26 not located as direct files.
Port-level split of third-country transit cargo (Kolkata/Haldia vs Visakhapatnam) - requires Nepal Intermodal Transport Development Board or Indian port data; no lead located.
Seat-capacity data by hub (OAG/IATA) are licensed and not in the catalog.
Invoicing/settlement currency of trade (INR vs convertible) - no tabulation located.
Bank-level correspondent-relationship data for Nepal - likely supervisory, not public.
Location-level capital-stock valuation for EXP-20 - not published.
Official verification of reported 2026 events (Middle East conflict impacts on Nepali workers, Gulf permit suspension, Rasuwagadhi-Kerung flood, Tatopani closure).

assumptions.text: HHI and top-k shares are the standard concentration metrics for all partner dimensions; unit 'index' for HHI, 'percent' for shares.
A 'glacier/snow-fed' hydropower classification threshold (EXP-07) must be set by 25A as a labelled assumption; 16B does not set it.
HS-to-ECCN concordance for EXP-19 is an assumption to be documented by 19B; the metric is therefore an estimate, not a fact.
Register corrections and new entries are proposals only; the register file research/global_exposure/exposure_register.json is not edited in r1.

challenges.text: EXP-02 counterparties omit India; DoFE approvals exclude India-bound and irregular migrants. Combine with Census 2021 absentee data and keep flows and stocks separate (proposed EXP-P03).
EXP-01 corridor shares cannot be sourced from NRB BoP alone; NLSS IV (survey, incl. informal) and KNOMAD (modelled) must be reported as separate values with methodological notes.
EXP-15 owner 21D is not an owner of channel agricultural_output; EXP-16 domestic-production share ignores imported APIs (proposed EXP-P09); food staples lack an entry (proposed EXP-P01).
EXP-17 uses unit 'ratio' for a count of relationships; split into a count and a percent share. units.py has no count unit - raise with 00A.
EXP-12: NRB realised FDI and DoI/IBN approvals differ methodologically; report both, do not substitute.
Source catalog lacks Nepal Intermodal Transport Development Board / Nepal Transit and Warehousing Company, ITC, World Bank Commodity Markets, IATA/OAG; several leads carry source_id null.
Escalation: candidate SPOF-03, SPOF-04 and EXP-13 timing may change conclusions of S01, S05, S08 and S10 once 2026 events are verified (leads L34, L47, L48, L52).
Request red-team review of the SPOF list and of the proposed EXP-P01..P09 for omissions (e.g. single-gateway telecom/internet backbone via India/China not yet assessed).

uncertainty: High. No concentration metric is quantified in r1. Candidate single points of failure rest on the content description of located documents and on search results, not on retrieved evidence; severity is unknown. Corridor-level remittance concentration will remain uncertain even after retrieval because the available sources measure different concepts (survey receipts vs modelled allocation). Several leads (customs, DoFE) point to older vintages or landing pages; the newest tables may require manual download.

exposure_register_entries.title: Remittance dependence and corridor concentration
exposure_register_entries.primary_tables: NRB CME annual/monthly tables: workers' remittances and personal remittances (BoP secondary income), FY2024/25 and history; NSO NLSS IV Chapter 16 remittance by source; NLSS IV microdata by sender country; KNOMAD bilateral matrix (Nepal as recipient)
exposure_register_entries.measurement_method: Ratio of personal remittances to nominal GDP on the same Nepal FY basis (NRB numerator, NSO GDP denominator); corridor shares from NLSS IV (survey) and KNOMAD (modelled) kept as separate values
exposure_register_entries.methodological_issues: NRB BoP does not (to our knowledge, to be verified) publish remittances by sending country; NLSS captures household receipts incl. informal channels, KNOMAD allocates by migrant stock and income - three different concepts. Personal remittances vs workers' remittances differ in BPM6 coverage.
exposure_register_entries.suggested_register_changes_not_applied: Add India explicitly as separate corridor (already listed) and note that corridor shares cannot come from NRB alone; add knomad caveat 'modelled'.

exposure_register_entries.title: Migrant workers by destination
exposure_register_entries.primary_tables: DoFE labour approvals by destination (Nepal Labour Migration Report 2024, FY2022/23-FY2023/24; DoFE yearly progress reports for later FYs); NPHC 2021 absent population by destination; GLMM host-country nationality tables
exposure_register_entries.measurement_method: Flows (approvals per FY) and stocks (census absentees, host-country counts) recorded as separate series; never sum approvals into stock without a documented attrition/return assumption
exposure_register_entries.methodological_issues: DoFE approvals exclude India (no permit) and irregular migrants and count renewals separately; census counts absentees reported by households at the census reference date; host-country data have mixed vintages.
exposure_register_entries.suggested_register_changes_not_applied: Add 'India' to counterparties (largest open-border corridor, not captured by DoFE). Split metric into 'approvals (flow)' and 'stock' with different units/periods.

exposure_register_entries.title: Goods trade concentration with India
exposure_register_entries.primary_tables: Department of Customs annual Foreign Trade Statistics book (partner-country tables) FY2022/23 and later books; Nepal Trade Information Portal partner queries; NRB CME trade-by-India/China/others table; UN Comtrade mirror data (India-reported exports to Nepal)
exposure_register_entries.measurement_method: India share = imports from India / total imports and exports to India / total exports, Nepal FY, customs basis; mirror comparison as a conflict check
exposure_register_entries.methodological_issues: Customs (FY, CIF imports) vs India-reported exports (Indian FY or calendar year, FOB) differ in valuation, timing and informal trade; electricity exports may or may not be included in customs totals depending on year - verify.
exposure_register_entries.suggested_register_changes_not_applied: Owner 04A is domestic; recommend 17A as external co-owner.

exposure_register_entries.title: Third-country trade transit via Indian ports
exposure_register_entries.primary_tables: Customs statistics by customs office (Birgunj/ICD, Biratnagar, Bhairahawa, etc.) combined with transit declarations; Treaty of Transit and letters of exchange (designated ports and corridors); World Bank NIRTTP project documents; LPI 2023
exposure_register_entries.measurement_method: Third-country imports (non-India origin) entering via southern customs offices = proxy for Indian-port transit; share by port requires transit declaration data (ECTS/NITDB) not yet located
exposure_register_entries.methodological_issues: Customs records country of origin, not route; imports of Chinese origin can transit Indian ports or come overland via northern crossings. Port-level split needs Nepal Intermodal Transport Development Board or Indian port data (not located).
exposure_register_entries.suggested_register_changes_not_applied: Source list lacks the Nepal Intermodal Transport Development Board / Nepal Transit and Warehousing Company (not in catalog); propose adding.

exposure_register_entries.title: Petroleum import dependence and supplier
exposure_register_entries.primary_tables: NOC import and sales volumes by product and FY; customs HS 27 imports by partner; NRB CME major-imports table (petroleum products value); IOC supply agreement documents
exposure_register_entries.measurement_method: Petroleum share of imports = HS 27 (petroleum products) value / total imports (Nepal FY); supplier share = volume via IOC / total NOC imports; LPG treated separately
exposure_register_entries.methodological_issues: Customs value vs NOC procurement cost differ (pricing formula, timing); some aviation fuel and LPG channels may differ from petrol/diesel supply route.
exposure_register_entries.suggested_register_changes_not_applied: Split into liquid fuels vs LPG; add pipeline/depot route as SPOF attribute.

exposure_register_entries.title: Cross-border electricity trade
exposure_register_entries.primary_tables: NEA annual report energy balance: exports to India and Bangladesh, imports from India, by month/season (FY); CEA India approvals of Nepali projects for cross-border sale
exposure_register_entries.measurement_method: GWh exported/imported by counterparty and by wet/dry season; revenue separately in NPR
exposure_register_entries.methodological_issues: Bangladesh sales transit Indian grid (trilateral arrangement) - counterparty vs route differ; NEA units in kWh/'units' convert to GWh.
exposure_register_entries.suggested_register_changes_not_applied: Add 'route: India grid' attribute for Bangladesh flows.

exposure_register_entries.title: Glacier- and snow-fed share of hydropower
exposure_register_entries.primary_tables: NEA annual report generation by plant and river basin; ICIMOD basin hydrology studies; ICIMOD/UNDP glacial lake inventory
exposure_register_entries.measurement_method: Capacity (MW) located in basins with significant snow/glacier melt contribution / total capacity; threshold for 'glacier/snow-fed' is an explicit assumption to be set by 25A
exposure_register_entries.methodological_issues: No official classification of plants by melt share; requires hydrological-model evidence per basin.
exposure_register_entries.suggested_register_changes_not_applied: Unit percent is fine; add the classification threshold as a labelled assumption.

exposure_register_entries.title: Tourism source markets
exposure_register_entries.primary_tables: Nepal Tourism Statistics (calendar year) arrivals by nationality and mode; NRB CME travel receipts (FY)
exposure_register_entries.measurement_method: Arrival shares by origin (calendar year); travel receipts / GDP (Nepal FY) - keep as two separate metrics
exposure_register_entries.methodological_issues: Calendar year vs FY mismatch; coverage of Indian arrivals by land requires verification; receipts are not split by origin.
exposure_register_entries.suggested_register_changes_not_applied: Split into two metrics with explicit period basis.

exposure_register_entries.title: Air connectivity through Gulf hubs
exposure_register_entries.primary_tables: CAAN international airlines list and TIA brief; CAAN air traffic demand study; airline schedules (licensed data, not in catalog)
exposure_register_entries.measurement_method: Share of weekly international seats operated by Gulf- and India-hub carriers (seat-capacity basis)
exposure_register_entries.methodological_issues: Seat data from OAG/IATA are licensed; CAAN publications may provide flights/seats only in aggregate.
exposure_register_entries.suggested_register_changes_not_applied: Add 'single international gateway (TIA)' attribute; consider new SPOF entry.

exposure_register_entries.title: NPR-INR peg and INR/USD exposure
exposure_register_entries.primary_tables: NRB monetary policy statement (peg); NRB FXM directives on INR vs convertible-currency payment for imports from India; RBI exchange-control supplement for Nepal; NRB CME tables on convertible-currency purchase/INR
exposure_register_entries.measurement_method: Share of merchandise trade settled in INR vs convertible currency (Nepal FY); INR/USD volatility from RBI reference rate
exposure_register_entries.methodological_issues: Invoicing currency is not tabulated by customs; settlement currency may be derivable from NRB foreign-exchange tables - to be verified.
exposure_register_entries.suggested_register_changes_not_applied: Channel 'exchange_rate' is a projection channel - fine; add rbi series id once retrieved.

exposure_register_entries.title: External public debt by creditor and currency
exposure_register_entries.primary_tables: PDMO monthly Government Debt Statistics (creditor and currency tables), Public Debt Bulletin, MTDS report; World Bank IDS; IMF 2026 Article IV DSA
exposure_register_entries.measurement_method: Creditor shares and currency shares of central-government external debt (PDMO, month-end within Nepal FY); IDS totals as separate calendar-year series
exposure_register_entries.methodological_issues: PDMO covers central-government external debt; IDS covers total external debt incl. private and publicly guaranteed; SDR-denominated IDA/IMF debt affects currency composition.
exposure_register_entries.suggested_register_changes_not_applied: Add currency (SDR/USD/JPY/CNY) as explicit sub-metric.

exposure_register_entries.title: FDI by source country
exposure_register_entries.primary_tables: NRB Survey Report on FDI in Nepal 2023/24 and 2022/23 (stock by source country and sector); Department of Industry approvals
exposure_register_entries.measurement_method: FDI stock share by source country (end-FY, NRB survey); approvals kept separate
exposure_register_entries.methodological_issues: Approved (DoI/IBN) vs realised (NRB) FDI differ widely; round-tripping and ultimate vs immediate investor country.
exposure_register_entries.suggested_register_changes_not_applied: Owner 12B domestic; add 18B/18D as external co-owners.

exposure_register_entries.title: Loss of LDC-specific trade preferences
exposure_register_entries.primary_tables: WTO/EIF trade impacts of LDC graduation (Nepal chapters); ITC Nepal after LDC graduation; UN CDP crisis assessment July 2026; ILO employment impact assessment; WTO tariff data
exposure_register_entries.measurement_method: Value of exports entering markets under LDC-only preferences / total goods exports, by market, for the latest FY with customs HS-8 data
exposure_register_entries.methodological_issues: Utilisation of preferences vs eligibility; EU/UK transition periods and the possible extension of Nepal's preparatory period change timing.
exposure_register_entries.suggested_register_changes_not_applied: Add 'graduation effective date' as a dated event attribute; status of Nepal's extension request pending.

exposure_register_entries.title: Digital-service exports exposed to AI substitution
exposure_register_entries.primary_tables: NRB BoP services lines (telecom/computer/information; other business services); UNCTAD digitally deliverable services; industry surveys (secondary)
exposure_register_entries.measurement_method: ICT/BPO exports value (USD, FY) by segment; destination split pending a survey source
exposure_register_entries.methodological_issues: Possible misclassification of service receipts as remittances; no official destination breakdown.
exposure_register_entries.suggested_register_changes_not_applied: Add 'measurement conflict flag' until NRB and industry figures are reconciled.

exposure_register_entries.title: Fertiliser import dependence
exposure_register_entries.primary_tables: Customs HS 31 imports by partner; FAOSTAT fertiliser use and imports; G2G fertiliser agreement with India (AICL/STCL) documents
exposure_register_entries.measurement_method: Imported share of fertiliser use = imports (nutrient tonnes) / use; supplier HHI from customs partner data
exposure_register_entries.methodological_issues: Informal cross-border fertiliser flows are unrecorded; FAO nutrient basis vs customs product tonnes.
exposure_register_entries.suggested_register_changes_not_applied: Channel agricultural_output owners (07A, 25E) do not include owner 21D; add 21D to channel owners.

exposure_register_entries.title: Medicine and medical-supply import dependence
exposure_register_entries.primary_tables: DDA annual reports (domestic vs imported market share by origin); customs HS 30 imports by partner; Pharmexcil profile (secondary)
exposure_register_entries.measurement_method: Imported share of pharmaceutical consumption (value) and India share of imports
exposure_register_entries.methodological_issues: Domestic production relies on imported APIs (active ingredients) - 'domestic' share overstates independence; API origin (China/India) must be tracked.
exposure_register_entries.suggested_register_changes_not_applied: Channel 'transit_and_logistics' is imperfect; consider an 'essential_supplies' channel or map to 21D explicitly; add API dependence sub-metric.

exposure_register_entries.title: Correspondent banking concentration
exposure_register_entries.primary_tables: BIS CPMI correspondent banking data for Nepal; NRB Financial Stability Report; NRB FXM circulars; FIU-Nepal newsletter
exposure_register_entries.measurement_method: Number of active correspondent relationships and share of USD/INR payment value via top-3 correspondents
exposure_register_entries.methodological_issues: BIS data are SWIFT-based and country-level; bank-level concentration requires NRB supervisory data that may not be public.
exposure_register_entries.suggested_register_changes_not_applied: Unit 'ratio' for a count is inconsistent - split into a count of relationships (units.py has no count unit; raise with 00A) and a share (percent).

exposure_register_entries.title: FATF/APG standing
exposure_register_entries.primary_tables: FATF Nepal country page and plenary statements (Feb 2025 onward); APG MER 2023 and follow-up report 2025
exposure_register_entries.measurement_method: Listing status (categorical) and number of open action-plan items / MER ratings
exposure_register_entries.methodological_issues: Categorical status is not an index; encode as an ordinal code with a documented mapping.
exposure_register_entries.suggested_register_changes_not_applied: Unit 'index' should be documented as ordinal mapping (e.g. not listed / increased monitoring / call for action).

exposure_register_entries.title: Imported technology subject to export controls
exposure_register_entries.primary_tables: BIS Commerce Country Chart and EAR country groups for Nepal; customs HS 84/85 imports by partner; UN Comtrade mirror
exposure_register_entries.measurement_method: Share of ICT capital imports falling under ECCN-controlled categories; requires HS-to-ECCN concordance (assumption)
exposure_register_entries.methodological_issues: No official HS-ECCN concordance; controls apply to items/end-users, not to HS lines.
exposure_register_entries.suggested_register_changes_not_applied: Mark metric as estimate-type requiring a labelled concordance assumption.

exposure_register_entries.title: Transboundary flood exposure
exposure_register_entries.primary_tables: ICIMOD/UNDP glacial lake inventory; ICIMOD Kyirong-Rasuwa 2026 flood page; BIPAD incident database; ThinkHazard river flood class
exposure_register_entries.measurement_method: Capital stock (hydropower plants, roads, customs/border facilities) located in mapped cross-border flood/GLOF zones; requires asset inventory and hazard polygons
exposure_register_entries.methodological_issues: Capital-stock valuation of assets is not published at location level; ThinkHazard provides hazard class, not exposure value.
exposure_register_entries.suggested_register_changes_not_applied: Add Rasuwagadhi-Kerung and Tatopani-Zhangmu corridors as named assets; link to proposed northern-border entry.

single_points_of_failure.name: Single petroleum supplier and India-only supply routes
single_points_of_failure.description: NOC documents describe petroleum imports under a long-term arrangement with Indian Oil Corporation, supplied from Indian depots; NOC holds the import right for petrol and diesel. Supplier, route and importer are each concentrated.
single_points_of_failure.evidence_status: qualitative candidate identified from search-located documents; not yet verified from retrieved primary documents
single_points_of_failure.measure_needed: Supplier share by volume; days of storage cover; share by entry route (pipeline vs road)

single_points_of_failure.name: Indian seaports and designated transit corridors for third-country trade
single_points_of_failure.description: Third-country trade depends on Kolkata/Haldia and Visakhapatnam ports and designated road/rail corridors to Nepal's southern border (Birgunj ICD and others) under the Treaty of Transit.
single_points_of_failure.evidence_status: qualitative candidate identified from search-located documents; not yet verified from retrieved primary documents
single_points_of_failure.measure_needed: Share of third-country imports by port and corridor; dwell/transit times; alternative-route capacity

single_points_of_failure.name: Northern land crossings with China (Rasuwagadhi-Kerung, Tatopani-Zhangmu)
single_points_of_failure.description: The main northern trade crossings are few and located in high-hazard valleys; ICIMOD reports a 2026 cross-border flood affecting Rasuwagadhi-Kerung, and other search results report closure of Tatopani (unverified).
single_points_of_failure.evidence_status: qualitative candidate identified from search-located documents; not yet verified from retrieved primary documents
single_points_of_failure.measure_needed: Share of China-origin imports by crossing; closure days per year; reconstruction timeline

single_points_of_failure.name: Gulf (GCC) and Malaysian labour markets
single_points_of_failure.description: Labour-approval destinations are concentrated in a few GCC states and Malaysia; a 2026 Middle East conflict and a reported temporary suspension of labour permits for the region (unverified) illustrate simultaneous hit to employment, remittances and aviation.
single_points_of_failure.evidence_status: qualitative candidate identified from search-located documents; not yet verified from retrieved primary documents
single_points_of_failure.measure_needed: Approvals HHI; remittance corridor shares; stock at risk in conflict-affected states

single_points_of_failure.name: India open-border labour market
single_points_of_failure.description: Migration to India is unregulated by labour permits and absent from DoFE statistics; a policy or security change at the open border affects a large unmeasured corridor.
single_points_of_failure.evidence_status: qualitative candidate identified from search-located documents; not yet verified from retrieved primary documents
single_points_of_failure.measure_needed: Census absentee stock in India; NLSS remittance share from India

single_points_of_failure.name: Tribhuvan International Airport and Gulf-hub carriers
single_points_of_failure.description: International passenger access concentrates at one main gateway (TIA) and on carriers routing via Gulf and Indian hubs; airspace closures in the Gulf hit tourists and migrant travel together.
single_points_of_failure.evidence_status: qualitative candidate identified from search-located documents; not yet verified from retrieved primary documents
single_points_of_failure.measure_needed: Share of international seats at TIA and via Gulf hubs; alternative airport capacity

single_points_of_failure.name: USD correspondent-banking access under FATF increased monitoring
single_points_of_failure.description: FATF publications list Nepal under increased monitoring from February 2025 (to be confirmed from retrieved document); de-risking by a small number of USD/INR correspondents could raise remittance and trade-payment costs.
single_points_of_failure.evidence_status: qualitative candidate identified from search-located documents; not yet verified from retrieved primary documents
single_points_of_failure.measure_needed: Active correspondents count; top-3 share; open action items

single_points_of_failure.name: India as sole market and transit grid for electricity exports
single_points_of_failure.description: Electricity exports go to India or through the Indian grid to Bangladesh, and depend on project-by-project approval by the Indian designated authority; dry-season imports come from India.
single_points_of_failure.evidence_status: qualitative candidate identified from search-located documents; not yet verified from retrieved primary documents
single_points_of_failure.measure_needed: Export GWh by counterparty; share of approved vs installed export-capable capacity; dry-season import dependence

single_points_of_failure.name: India as dominant supplier of fertiliser, medicines and food staples
single_points_of_failure.description: Fertiliser supply relies on a government-to-government arrangement with India; medicines and rice/paddy are largely sourced from India; Indian export restrictions (e.g. the 2023 non-basmati rice restriction) transmit directly.
single_points_of_failure.evidence_status: qualitative candidate identified from search-located documents; not yet verified from retrieved primary documents
single_points_of_failure.measure_needed: India share by HS group; stock cover; frequency of Indian export restrictions

single_points_of_failure.name: NPR-INR peg as single nominal anchor
single_points_of_failure.description: The fixed NPR-INR peg transmits INR/USD movements and Indian monetary conditions to Nepal; a disorderly INR move or peg stress is a single-point exposure for prices and debt service in USD/SDR.
single_points_of_failure.evidence_status: qualitative candidate identified from search-located documents; not yet verified from retrieved primary documents
single_points_of_failure.measure_needed: INR/USD volatility; share of trade and debt in non-INR currencies

single_points_of_failure.name: Upstream cryosphere hazards in Tibet (China) for Koshi and Trishuli basins
single_points_of_failure.description: Potentially dangerous glacial lakes in upstream Tibetan catchments can generate floods in Nepal that Nepal cannot monitor alone; hydropower and border infrastructure in these valleys are exposed.
single_points_of_failure.evidence_status: qualitative candidate identified from search-located documents; not yet verified from retrieved primary documents
single_points_of_failure.measure_needed: Capacity (MW) and assets downstream of listed lakes; early-warning data-sharing arrangements

single_points_of_failure.name: Concessional creditor concentration (IDA and ADB)
single_points_of_failure.description: External public debt is dominated by a few multilateral creditors; changes in their allocation or terms (e.g. income-category transitions) affect financing more than market conditions.
single_points_of_failure.evidence_status: qualitative candidate identified from search-located documents; not yet verified from retrieved primary documents
single_points_of_failure.measure_needed: Creditor HHI; share of new commitments by creditor; terms change triggers

proposed_new_exposure_entries.title: Food-staple import dependence and Indian export restrictions (rice/paddy, sugar, pulses, edible oil)
proposed_new_exposure_entries.metric: imported share of consumption; India share of imports; restriction events per year
proposed_new_exposure_entries.rationale: Not covered by EXP-15/16; Indian export restrictions are a documented transmission path.

proposed_new_exposure_entries.title: Northern border crossings with China
proposed_new_exposure_entries.metric: share of China-origin imports by crossing; closure days
proposed_new_exposure_entries.rationale: EXP-04 covers only Indian ports; the 2026 Rasuwagadhi event (to be verified) shows a separate exposure.

proposed_new_exposure_entries.title: India open-border migration and remittances
proposed_new_exposure_entries.metric: absentee stock in India; remittance share from India
proposed_new_exposure_entries.rationale: EXP-02 counterparties omit India; DoFE data exclude it.

proposed_new_exposure_entries.title: Remittance transfer-channel concentration (licensed remittance companies, banks, informal hundi)
proposed_new_exposure_entries.metric: share of formal inflows via top-3 providers; formal vs informal share
proposed_new_exposure_entries.rationale: Grey-listing and de-risking act on channels, not corridors.

proposed_new_exposure_entries.title: Government-to-government labour programmes (Korea EPS, Japan SSW) and policy-contingent corridors
proposed_new_exposure_entries.rationale: Higher-wage corridors governed by bilateral quotas; distinct risk profile from GCC.

proposed_new_exposure_entries.title: Grant and concessional aid dependence by donor, incl. LDC-linked support (EIF, LDCF)
proposed_new_exposure_entries.metric: grants by donor / total grants; LDC-contingent share
proposed_new_exposure_entries.rationale: No register entry covers grants; LDC graduation affects LDC-specific finance.

proposed_new_exposure_entries.title: External borrowing-cost exposure (variable-rate and non-concessional debt)
proposed_new_exposure_entries.metric: share of external debt at variable or market-linked rates
proposed_new_exposure_entries.rationale: The global_interest_rates channel has no register entry.

proposed_new_exposure_entries.title: Digital platform and payment-network dependence (cloud, card networks, app stores, freelancing platforms)
proposed_new_exposure_entries.metric: share of ICT export receipts via foreign platforms; availability of international payment gateways
proposed_new_exposure_entries.rationale: Sanctions or de-platforming risk distinct from AI substitution in EXP-14.

proposed_new_exposure_entries.title: Active-pharmaceutical-ingredient (API) origin for domestic medicine production
proposed_new_exposure_entries.metric: share of API imports by origin
